{{Quote|Enough! I've tried playing nice but if you want to play destruction&hellip; Destruction it is!!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Loka Hask]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 7">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 7|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 7]]</ref>}}
The '''mission to Mrlsst''' occurred when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces attacked [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to recover the [[Phantom Project]] and were repulsed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Phantom Project was a fake! It was invented to milk the Empire for money.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 7" />}}
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the new [[President/Legends|president]] of the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy|Mrlsst Academy]], [[Gyr Keela]], decided to put the [[Phantom Project]], a new [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] technology, up for bids to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. The Phantom Project was in fact a con created by his predecessor, [[Rorax Falken]], to racketeer the Empire. Aware of the truth, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was sent to [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in order to represent the New Republic and reinforce the illusion. Capain [[Loka Hask]], who was responsible for the deaths of Wedge Antilles's parents, arrived to [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] with the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Interdictor-class)|''Dominator'']] as the negotiating representative of the Empire to acquire the technology.

==The battle==
{{Dialogue|Loka Hask|You say it's a pocket Death Star we have here?!|Gade Yedan|Yes. It's terrible&hellip;|Hask|It's wonderful! Why are those lights blinking?|Yedan|What lights? Oh, no!|attr=Captain Loka Hask and [[Gade Yedan]], seconds before their death|src=<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 8">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 8|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 8]]</ref>}}

[[File:Rogues_escape_on_Mrlsst.jpg|thumb|left|130px|[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] escape [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].]]

Hostilities began when activists of the [[Ante-Endor Association]] killed some students of the academy in trying to steal [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] about the project. They left proofs compromising [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] that forced Gyr Keela to place Antilles under arrest. Hask's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] later tried to arrest the other Rogues who managed to escape with the help of [[Koyi Komad]]. Antilles was eventually freed by a [[Mrlssti Laser Phantoms|holographic image]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Taj Junak]] controlled by Rorax Falken.

Hask, angered by this, launched his [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] and bombarded the Academy grounds of Mrlsst. Rogues [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] intercepted most Imperial fighters but civilian causalities and damaged to the city were huge. Meanwhile, some other Rogues joined [[Falken's Lab|Falken's scientific laboratory]] on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] orbiting the planet. Under questioning from Nep and Terrik, Falken and his students admitted that the Phantom Project was just a hoax, designed to elicit funding from the Empire.
[[File:Bombing_Mrlsst.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] bombing [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]].]]

Captain Hask and Imperial forces soon arrived to the station to retrieve the plans. While the stormtroopers fought a holographic ghost Jedi controlled by Falken, [[Dllr Nep]], [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] and the students retreated to the hangar and boarded Terrik's ''[[Pulsar Skate]]''. Falken and [[Groznik]] were killed by Loka Hask. The ''Pulsar Skate'' attempted to evade the pursuing TIE fighters but was largely defenseless until the arrival of Rogue Squadron. As the Imperial Star Destroyer closed on the ''Pulsar Skate'', Nep and Terrik activated the [[gravitic polarization beam]], a powerful weapon that created a [[Wormhole/Legends|hyperspace wormhole]] and destroyed both the lab and the Star Destroyer.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We known if it's best to never use it!''"<br />"''It's an old question: should a soldier not have a weapon which his enemy might have?|Wedge Antilles and Mirax Terrik|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 8" />}}
[[File:Wormhole_Dominator.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The destruction of the [[Dominator (Interdictor-class)|''Dominator'']].]]
Wedge Antilles recovered the gravitic polarization beam and decided it was too powerful to be used again. Despite the huge civilian casualties, President Gyr Keela saw those events as a chance to strengthen the unity of the [[Mrlssi]] people.
